'''Ballas1''' is an unnamed character model in ''[[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]''. He is a member of the [[Ballas (3D Universe)|Ballas]].

He is also available as a playable character in the official [[Multiplayer in GTA San Andreas|2 player mode]] exclusive to the [[PlayStation 2]] version of the game.

==Character==
===Appearance===
Ballas1 wears a purple bandana tied at the front, a white T-shirt, purple shorts, and white socks with flip-flops. His character model is not unique and is shared with many other Ballas members.

In ''[[Grand Theft Auto: The Trilogy - The Definitive Edition|The Definitive Edition]]'', he has a majority of variants. He can often be seen without the purple bandana on his head and he can also wear reverted colors in terms of clothing (e.g. purple shirt, white shorts). He also has either a black shirt or black shorts, while his socks only obtain purple a stripe and the flip-flops remain unchanged.

In the [[Beta Content in GTA San Andreas/Characters#Ballas|beta]], Ballas1 had a slightly different appearance; his T-shirt is tucked into his shorts and he lacks his purple bandana.
